risk.rationale: Incorrect state or cache reuse can display stale items when navigating this synthetic public catalog. The exercise uses one local process with reversible changes. State transitions and cross-request tests address its main risks.

criteria.scopeDescription: Check selected nonempty category against the fixed catalog at list_items, including identity of returned items, case sensitivity and filtered count.

obligations.description: Return only exact category matches and compute total from the matching rows.

comparisonContexts.description: Select tools from a catalog containing books and tools and inspect IDs and total.
Change only case to Tools. The fixed catalog has no matching category.

criteria.scopeDescription: Check UI state and the page sent to the API when selecting tools, including a transition from page three.

obligations.description: Select the new category and use page one when issuing its request.

comparisonContexts.description: Observe category, page and returned items after selection when the view starts on page one.
Inspect view state after changing category on page three and the page recorded at API entry.

criteria.scopeDescription: Check an in-process API instance across repeated requests and across changes of category, page or page size.

obligations.description: Cache and retrieve the correct result for each category, page and page_size tuple on the same instance.

comparisonContexts.description: Repeat tools page one on a single API object.
Hold books constant while independently varying page and page size.
Hold page one and size two constant across books then tools on the same instance.

criteria.scopeDescription: Check the fixed-category pagination contract at the service and its in-process API wrapper. Direct API checks cover in-range slices. The empty-page API behavior is a composition inference for a fixed category from service execution and the wrapper's unchanged response on a cache miss or hit.

obligations.description: Preserve catalog order, bound the slice by page size and retain the filtered total when a slice is empty.

comparisonContexts.description: Combine service checks of the middle and out-of-range slices with API checks of page progression and size. On a single-category instance the cache key distinguishes page and size, and get_items returns the cached service response.

evidenceReviews.rationale: At the pinned head, the service test passed its exact tools IDs and total assertions and the zero total assertion for Tools.
At the pinned head, the service test passed the books middle-slice assertion and the full empty tools page-three response assertion.
At the pinned head, both calls for tools yielded the expected IDs and the cache had one entry.
At the pinned head, all three ordered books ID comparisons at the API passed for two page numbers and two sizes.
At the pinned head, changing to tools from the default first page preserved page one and returned the expected tools IDs.
The pinned historical test stopped at the state assertion with actual page three and expected page one. Its later returned-items assertion did not execute.
The offered probe at the pinned head compared the recorded API call with tools page one, size two. It recorded page three.
The offered probe at the pinned head observed book IDs in the second response requested for tools. Its later tools total assertion did not execute.

bindings.rationale: The service returned T1 and T2 with total two for tools in the mixed fixture. That checks membership and filtered count.
Tools yielded total zero while tools yielded two. The service constructs the returned slice and total from the same equality-filtered rows.
The initial page-one path preserved the new category and page, and the view returned T1 and T2. This covers the initially first-page path only.
The view remained on page three after selecting tools. Restore page one before forwarding the request and rerun the state check.
The recording API captured tools, page three, size two where the probe required page one. This directly identifies the wrong argument at call time.
Two identical requests returned the expected tools IDs and reused one entry. The category stayed constant throughout.
The API returned B1/B2, then B3/B4 for page two, then B1 for size one with books held constant.
After caching books the API returned B1/B2 for tools where T1/T2 were required. The cache key omits category. Include category in the key and rerun the same-instance sequence.
The unit check observed ordered B3/B4 on books page two and an empty tools page three with total two and page three. These are service assertions.

API assertions observed B1/B2, B3/B4 and B1 over page and size changes for books. For the out-of-range clause, the service observation supplies the empty response and get_items stores and returns that response unchanged for a fixed category. An API call asserting an empty page and filtered total would independently check this inference.
